text: Access per graph: its owner, accounts with write access, and who may add notes
description:
Felix 2026-11-12: configurable in the Aimparency server per graph: who may add notes ("everyone" or "only selected accounts"), and you can grant write access to accounts. Whoever creates a graph owns it.

Replaces the roles of today's hosted mode, which apply to the whole server (read, write, admin in access.ts). Rights are per graph, not per idea: the owner and accounts with write access may change everything in the graph; everyone may read.

Notes themselves (the guest layer) are idea 34b3d747.

Unchanged from 2026-11-10: write access never allows starting a terminal or an agent on the server.

Assumed by Claude, not said by Felix: the server admin is a separate role (adds local checkouts and mirrors, removes graphs and accounts); only the owner grants write access and changes the notes setting; a mirrored graph has no writers on the server.

status.comment: Planned 2026-11-12 at Felix's request; nothing built.
